title: GravitasBench Episode
description: A complete benchmark episode record. Stores trajectory, telemetry, and validator outputs for reproducibility.

repo_commit.description: Git commit hash of the repository state at task start.

configuration.description: Configuration label, e.g. baseline, gravitas-core, gravitas-native, reference-sonnet

run_index.description: Which run of the 5 runs/task this is (1-5)

contract.description: The task contract used for this episode.

tool_calls.description: All tool calls made during the episode

tokens.description: Provider-reported token telemetry. Missing values are omitted, not recorded as zero.

quota_before.description: Quota state snapshot before task start

quota_after.description: Quota state snapshot after task completion

quota_consumed.description: Measured provider quota used by this episode, when available.

git_diff.description: git diff of all changes made during the episode

validator_outputs.description: Results from deterministic validators for each acceptance criterion

claimed_success.description: Did the agent claim the task was complete?

functional_solve.description: Did validators confirm the task was actually solved?

premature_action.description: Any write before read violation detected?

regression.description: Any tests broken that were passing before?

infrastructure_failure.description: True if the episode failed due to tool/environment failure rather than agent behavior. Classified INVALID, not FAIL.
